svg.title: LomoSapiens on a phone
svg.desc: A camera with a colour roll and nine recorded frames, in the phone's dark theme, switched to Archive paper in Settings. A winter landscape in low sun is analysed in two steps and shows its wide sharp zone, and is recorded as frame 10. The roll's ten frames are listed, frame 5, set four steps lighter than advised, is marked Too light with a developing note, and the Theory article on the sharp zone is opened.
